blocks.content: A walk in which an edge doesn't repeat is called a trail.
Let's look at another example of a trail.

blocks.alt: A Trail Which is Also a Circuit

blocks.content: If a trail starts and ends in the same vertex, it is called a circuit.
Therefore, the above trail is also a circuit because it starts and ends in vertex 1.
